label: Eye size

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #22 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: orbit diameter / L: 0.15 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.10 -> -100 = 0.05, +100 = 0.25 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.15) / 0.10)

region.mask_rule: orbit band + eyeball meshes (scale/move with the seats); bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Eyeball/orbit scale: orbit diameter as a fraction of L (cat 0.21 [S] -> +55; canid values are [E], anchored on the cat and the felid > canid pattern - the weakest numbers in the preset table, spec section 2.3). The eyeball does not shrink when the brow grows: apparent size loss under a heavy brow is eyelid aperture + shelf shadow, never this slider (brow-study section 5.8).
